name: Biocytogen Pharmaceuticals (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
summary: Biocytogen Pharmaceuticals (Beijing) Co., Ltd., established in 2009 and based in Beijing, is a global biotechnology company researching and developing antibody-based therapies. It has about a dozen candidates, two in multi-regional Phase II trials and two in Phase I, targeting cancer, autoimmune, inflammatory and metabolic diseases. The wider Biocytogen group, operating since 2008, makes and sells genetically modified animal models and offers preclinical research services using gene-humanized, PDX and humanized immune system models.
